interact_prompt._todo: OQ-HUD (M2 H1b commit 2): the prompt at the object (scripts/ui/interact_prompt.gd). Every number and text is a placeholder, not a design value. ONE prompt for exactly the target the Interact button acts on (revive > pickup > chest > door), drawn at the target's projected screen point (anchor_up_m above the target's point, per kind), or clamped to the screen edge (screen_margin_dp inside it) when off screen or behind the camera. Sizes are in HUD units (hud_arrangement.unit_frac_of_height of the height, floor unit_min_dp); the tap target is never under min_tap_dp in either side and is kept off other touch targets and the weapon block, objective strip and chip (avoid_gap_dp apart; their rects re-read every avoid_refresh_s) where it can be. Off screen the pointer is a short gold arrowhead toward the target; on screen a dark tail, a thin line and a gold marker at the target point. Input: it never consumes a touch; a press on it that is released within tap_max_s and moves at most tap_travel_dp from the press point is a TAP (one interact press and release); the revive prompt is a HOLD instead: once the finger has stayed within tap_travel_dp for hold_start_s it presses interact and holds it until the finger lifts or moves beyond tap_travel_dp. Any finger that moves beyond tap_travel_dp is a drag: the touch HUD turns the view (or moves the stick) from the press point as if the prompt were not there. enabled false hides it (the Interact button stays).
